content.title: Kimball Electronics (NASDAQ:KE) Reports Bullish Q3
content.summary: Global electronics contract manufacturer Kimball Electronics (NYSE:KE) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales fell by 2.3% year on year to $365.6 million. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $1.4 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.49 per share was 81.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
